classification.difficultyReason: Interpret outside painting of an open box as one base and four walls, then combine their rectangular areas without including a top.

content.prompt:
Beca makes an open box. She is going to paint the outside of the box.

Work out the total area to be painted.

spec.description: Open square-based shallow box with interior base visible, two base-direction dimension arrows labelled 17 cm, and a vertical dimension arrow labelled 2.5 cm. No top face is drawn. Decorative grey shading is omitted; white masks preserve occlusion. Wall thickness is not specified or invented.
spec.mathematics: Outside area consists of one 17 cm square base and four 17 cm by 2.5 cm rectangular sides.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the open box and its supplied dimensions are shown.

answer.worked:
There is no top to paint.

Base: $17\times17=289\,\mathrm{cm}^2$.

Four sides: $(17\times2.5)\times4=170\,\mathrm{cm}^2$.
$$\begin{aligned}A&=289+170\\A&=459\,\mathrm{cm}^2.\end{aligned}$$
